decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The proposed development, by reason of its excessive scale &amp; irregular shape, would be an undesirable addition that&nbsp;presents a discordant feature that is not subordinate to the host dwelling, results in the overdevelopment of the site&nbsp;and unbalances the symmetry across the semi-detached pair of dwellings.
